categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes signing and PSBT analysis in src/script/sign.cpp rather than RPC dispatch or framework machinery; behavior exposed by analyzepsbt belongs to PSBT/wallet handling.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches PSBT signature inspection used in wallet PSBT workflows and the GUI, matching wallet's coverage of PSBT handling.
categories.rationale: Fixes incorrect next-role classification in PSBT analysis for Taproot script-path inputs. When analyzing Taproot script-path spends, AnalyzePSBT classified the next role as updater instead of signer, causing the wallet GUI to display an inaccurate warning that inputs were missing information when the transaction was actually ready to sign.
